stages.name: 星降る夜
stages.description: 星空の下で旅が始まる
stages.prompt: high quality anime fantasy illustration, vast starry sky above an ancient kingdom, silver moonlight, intricate scenery

stages.name: 旅立ち
stages.description: 未知の世界へ踏み出す
stages.prompt: anime cinematic illustration, young adventurer on a winding path through an enchanted landscape, flowing cloak, epic scale

stages.name: 祈りの聖域
stages.description: 願いが静かに力を宿す
stages.prompt: anime fantasy illustration, sacred crystal sanctuary, hands clasped in prayer, gentle radiant magic, delicate details

stages.name: 奇跡の覚醒
stages.description: 秘められた力が目覚める
stages.prompt: epic anime fantasy illustration, magical transformation, luminous runes and swirling stardust, dramatic light

stages.name: 希望の夜明け
stages.description: 旅の先に新しい世界が広がる
stages.prompt: cinematic anime fantasy landscape, golden sunrise over mountains and castle, hopeful grand finale
